link.title: C++ Concepts is now a Leanpub course

entry.summary: When I published C++ Concepts as a book back in 2022, I was happy with how it turned out. It covered the right material at the right depth, and the feedback from readers was positive. But a book is a passive experience — you read, you nod, you move on. I recently learned about Leanpub courses and I thought that it’s time to try something new.
